::: {#rem-confidence-interval-exact}
#### Why most intervals are conservative

@def-confidence-interval requires the [confidence coefficient](#def-confidence-coefficient)
to be at least $1 - \siglevel$.
The [coverage probability](#def-coverage-probability) can depend on $\param$,
and the confidence coefficient is its smallest value.
[Discrete](data.qmd#def-discrete-var) data take only finitely many values in a given sample size,
so they usually allow only a [conservative](#def-conservative-confidence-interval) interval,
as @exm-conservative-interval shows.
:::
